follow_ups.note: Optional test hardening. Mutants M4 and M6, where the Overview or Dispatch 'Running now' tile reads Date.now() itself instead of renderNow, pass all 89 checks. They survive because endsWhileDrawn flips the clock only when the panel's innerHTML is assigned, which happens after the tile has read the clock. Both fail safe: the time only moves forward, so a later reading can only show idle early, and the next tick redraws. A harness that flips the clock after renderAll's first reading would pin the renderers too.

Behaviour note, not a defect. Under a project session filter, agentRunning() counts the project's runs, so the pipeline arrows move while another session of the project runs an agent, even when the filtered pipeline shows no running node. This matches the header's documented 'live whichever session the filter shows' rule. Change it only if the owner wants the arrows scoped to the filter.
